22139.name: Kardimo Palettan
22139.description: A member of Ekdit Spitek's census gathering team.

22155.name: Sispur's Security Camera Logs
22155.description: These security camera digital recordings date back a few weeks, mainly portraying the coming and goings of personnel on Sispur's Estate.

22203.name: Angel Drug Addict Tag
22203.description: This tag was carried by an Angel Cartel drug addict.

22219.name: Replacement Laboratory Equipment
22219.description: These basic elements of all electronic hardware are sought out by those who require spare parts in their hardware. These specific parts are intended for repair and maintenance of a laboratory.

22315.name: Encoded RSS Brief
22315.description: This encoded brief may mean little to the untrained eye, but can prove valuable to the relevant institution.

22555.name: Mining Foreman Link - Mining Laser Field Enhancement I
22555.description:
Increases the range of the fleet's mining lasers, gas harvesters, ice harvesters and survey scanners.

Foreman Links are dedicated mining operation systems designed to assist foremen in coordinating their operations.

While only one of these units can normally be operated at any given time, certain advanced units allow the use of multiple systems. 

Note: The Fleet bonus only works if you are the assigned fleet booster.

22571.name: Inherent Implants 'Yeti' Ice Harvesting IH-1005
22571.description:
A neural Interface upgrade that boosts the pilot's skill at mining ice.

5% decrease in ice harvester cycle time.

22619.name: Frigoris Restrained Ice Harvester Upgrade
22619.description: Decreases the cycle time on Ice Harvester but causes them to use up more CPU.

22715.name: Republic Special Ops Field Enhancer - Gamma
22715.description: This image processor implanted in the parietal lobe grants a +4 bonus to one's Willpower and a 5% bonus to the ship's maximum speed.

22795.name: Gallente Corpse
22795.description: The corpse of someone with Gallentean ancestry.

22875.name: 'Aura' Warp Core Stabilizer I
22875.description:
When activated this unit attempts to compensate for fluctuations and disruptions of the ship's warp core. As a side effect, the host ship's maximum targeting range, scan resolution and drone bandwidth are penalized while this module is fitted.

Only one of this module type can be fitted at a time.

22891.name: 'Protest' Large Armor Repairer I
22891.description: This module uses nano-assemblers to repair damage done to the armor of the ship.

22907.name: 'Hooligan' Heavy Ion Blaster I
22907.description:
Particle blasters operate on a similar principle as the railgun except they fire a magnetically contained ball of subatomic particles. No other turret class can match the sheer destructive power of particle blasters, but due to the rapid dispersion of the containment field, it also has the worst range of all turrets. 

Requires hybrid charge types: Antimatter, Iridium, Iron, Lead, Plutonium, Thorium, Tungsten, Uranium.

22923.name: 'Wild' Miner I
22923.description: Basic mining laser. Extracts common ore quickly, but has difficulty with the more rare types.

22971.name: Federation Navy Iridium Charge S
22971.description:
Consists of two components: a shell of titanium and a core of iridium atoms suspended in plasma state. Railguns launch the shell directly, while particle blasters pump the plasma into a cyclotron and process the plasma into a bolt that is then fired.

20% increased optimal range.
24% reduced capacitor need.

22987.name: Federation Navy Iridium Charge M
22987.description:
Consists of two components: a shell of titanium and a core of iridium atoms suspended in plasma state. Railguns launch the shell directly, while particle blasters pump the plasma into a cyclotron and process the plasma into a bolt that is then fired.

20% increased optimal range.
24% reduced capacitor need.

23003.name: Federation Navy Iridium Charge L
23003.description:
Consists of two components: a shell of titanium and a core of iridium atoms suspended in plasma state. Railguns launch the shell directly, while particle blasters pump the plasma into a cyclotron and process the plasma into a bolt that is then fired.

20% increased optimal range.
24% reduced capacitor need.

23019.name: Caldari Navy Iridium Charge S
23019.description:
Consists of two components: a shell of titanium and a core of iridium atoms suspended in plasma state. Railguns launch the shell directly, while particle blasters pump the plasma into a cyclotron and process the plasma into a bolt that is then fired.

20% increased optimal range.
24% reduced capacitor need.

23035.name: Caldari Navy Iridium Charge M
23035.description:
Consists of two components: a shell of titanium and a core of iridium atoms suspended in plasma state. Railguns launch the shell directly, while particle blasters pump the plasma into a cyclotron and process the plasma into a bolt that is then fired.

20% increased optimal range.
24% reduced capacitor need.

23051.name: Caldari Navy Tungsten Charge L
23051.description:
Consists of two components: a shell of titanium and a core of tungsten atoms suspended in plasma state. Railguns launch the shell directly, while particle blasters pump the plasma into a cyclotron and process the plasma into a bolt that is then fired.

40% increased optimal range.
27% reduced capacitor need.

23083.name: Imperial Navy Microwave S
23083.description:
Modulates the beam of a laser weapon into the microwave frequencies. Improved range. Increased EM damage.

The delicate crystalline structures used in the manufacture of this advanced crystal degrade with use, eventually causing it to shatter.

40% increased optimal range.
25% reduced capacitor need.

23099.name: Imperial Navy Infrared M
23099.description:
Modulates the beam of a laser weapon into the infrared frequencies. Slightly improved range. Slightly increased EM damage.

The delicate crystalline structures used in the manufacture of this advanced crystal degrade with use, eventually causing it to shatter.

20% increased optimal range.
35% reduced capacitor need.

23115.name: Imperial Navy Infrared L
23115.description:
Modulates the beam of a laser weapon into the infrared frequencies. Slightly improved range. Slightly increased EM damage.

The delicate crystalline structures used in the manufacture of this advanced crystal degrade with use, eventually causing it to shatter.

20% increased optimal range.
35% reduced capacitor need.

23147.name: Takmahl Tri-polished Lens
23147.description: Alloys and special materials used in the manufacture of modules based on Ancient technology.

23163.name: Current Amplifier
23163.description: Alloys and special materials used in the manufacture of modules based on Ancient technology.

23179.name: Occult Accelerant
23179.description:
Unexceptional texts mostly aimed at rookie researchers wishing to increase the time efficiency of Amarr invention jobs.

Probability Multiplier: +20%
Max. Run Modifier: +1
Material Efficiency Modifier: +2
Time Efficiency Modifier: +10

23515.name: Strange DNA
23515.description:
DNA samples are any of various nucleic acids that are usually the molecular basis of heredity, are localized especially in cell nuclei, and are constructed of a double helix held together by hydrogen bonds between purine and pyrimidine bases which project inward from two chains containing alternate links of deoxyribose and phosphate.

This DNA sample is taken from the habitation module of the Serpentis agent, Elere Febre.

23547.name: Dolls
23547.description: Very lifelike dolls for little girls.

23675.name: Drone Observation Data
23675.description: Surveillance data and recordings gathered by the Thukkers on the rogue drones in the Skeletal Comet complex.

23739.name: Recon Speeders
23739.description: Reconnaissance vehicles that comprise an essential part of any respectable ground force.

23787.name: 'Chainmail' 200mm Steel Plates
23787.description:
Increases the maximum strength of the Armor.

Penalty: Adds to your ship's mass, making it less agile and maneuverable in addition to decreasing the factor of thrust gained from speed modules like Afterburners and MicroWarpdrives.

23803.name: 'Censer' Medium Cap Battery
23803.description: Increases capacitor storage. Provides defense against Energy Leech and Energy Neutralizer effects.

23819.name: Heavy 'Moat' Energy Neutralizer
23819.description: Neutralizes a portion of the energy in the target ship's capacitor.

23835.name: 'Mace' Dual Light Beam Laser I Blueprint

23883.name: Methros Enhanced Decoding Device
23883.description: A standard decoding device, used to decode valuable transmissions often sent via non-FTL transport.

23915.name: Chimera
23915.description: The Chimera's design is based upon the Kairiola, a vessel holding tremendous historical significance for the Caldari. Initially a water freighter, the Kairiola was refitted in the days of the Gallente-Caldari war to act as a fighter carrier during the orbital bombardment of Caldari Prime. It was most famously flown by the legendary Admiral Yakiya Tovil-Toba directly into Gallente Prime's atmosphere, where it fragmented and struck several key locations on the planet. This event, where the good Admiral gave his life, marked the culmination of a week's concentrated campaign of distraction which enabled the Caldari to evacuate their people from their besieged home planet. Where the Chimera roams, the Caldari remember. The Chimera is capable of generating a Jump Conduit Portal which allows it to instantaneously transport itself and nearby fleet members to a target cynosural beacon. Ship classes that can be moved via conduit: Frigates, Destroyers, Cruisers, Battlecruisers, and Battleships.

23931.name: House Methros Coat of Arms
23931.description: A heraldry emblem of the distinguished House Methros family.

24251.name: Pilgrims
24251.description: Amarr pilgrims seeking enlightenment at the holy sites that litter the Empire.

24283.name: Fighter Support Unit I
24283.description:
A combination of additional fighter hangar support drones, fighter power transmitters and advanced sensor support, the Fighter Support Unit assist all areas of fighter operation.

Note: Can only be fit to Carriers, Command Carriers and Supercarriers.
Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship or fighter squadron will be penalized.

24315.name: Thyram Arachnan's Dossier
24315.description: This detailed dossier contains encrypted evidence linking Thyram Arachnan, Amarrian nobleman, to criminal elements in the Araz constellation.

24395.name: Drone Navigation Computer I
24395.description:
Increases microwarpdrive speed of drones.
Increases the speed of fighters.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.

24443.name: Shield Boost Amplifier II
24443.description:
Focuses and amplifies the efficiency of shield boosting modules. 

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.

24475.name: Inferno Rage Rocket
24475.description:
A small rocket with a plasma warhead.

This modified version of the Inferno Rocket packs a considerably stronger punch, but as a result is heavier and slower. This makes it very effective against larger targets, but markedly less effective against smaller and more agile targets.

24491.name: Mjolnir Rage Heavy Assault Missile Blueprint

24507.name: Nova Fury Heavy Missile
24507.description:
The be-all and end-all of medium-sized missiles, the Nova heavy missile is a must for those who want a guaranteed kill no matter the cost.

A modified version of the Nova heavy missile. Does more damage than its predecessor but the volatile nature of the warhead, and its powerful containment system, reduce both flight time and precision.

24523.name: Mjolnir Rage Torpedo
24523.description:
An ultra-heavy EMP missile. While it is a slow projectile, its sheer damage potential is simply staggering.

This modified version of the Mjolnir Torpedo packs a considerably stronger punch, but as a result is heavier and slower. This makes it very effective against larger targets, but markedly less effective against smaller and more agile targets.

24539.name: Mjolnir Precision Cruise Missile
24539.description:
The mother of all missiles, the Mjolnir delivers a tremendous payload, guaranteed to get its victims acquainted with their personal god in a quick, but painful manner.

A modified version of the Mjolnir cruise. Great for taking down smaller ships, but fuel use by stabilization thrusters reduces maximum flight time.

24715.name: Severed Head
24715.description: This is the head of Ryoke Laika, a veteran Guristas pilot.

24731.name: Khanid Marine
24731.description: When war breaks out, the demand for transporting military personnel on site can exceed the grasp of the military organization. In these cases, the aid from non-military spacecrafts is often needed.

24763.name: Encryption Code Book
24763.description: A book used to decrypt messages

25275.name: Celadon Cytoserocin
25275.description: Cytoserocin is a crystalline compound formed by intense pressure deep within large asteroids and moons. It is used in electronics and weapon manufacturing, as well as the production of high-grade combat boosters. Cytoserocin can only be found in a few areas, such as interstellar gas clouds out in low security and 0.0 space.

25339.name: Pure Improved Frentix Booster
25339.description: Improved Frentix compound in its uncut form, ready to be processed into the final version of the combat booster.

25387.name: Guristas Armory Codes
25387.description: These complicated data sheets may mean little to the layman's eye, but can prove valuable in the right hands.

25467.name: Caldari Corpse
25467.description: The corpse of someone with Caldari ancestry.

25515.name: Nuomo's Voucher
25515.description: A voucher of approval.  The mayor of Pioneer's Sanctuary in ZH3-BS has asked the major players in town to hand vouchers like these to ship farers who have proven themselves through some dangerous feat.

25547.name: Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Neurotoxin Recovery NR-1003
25547.description:
A neural Interface upgrade that boost the pilot's skill at handling boosters. 

3% less chance of side effects when using boosters.

25563.name: Signal Distortion Amplifier II
25563.description:
Magnifies the operational ability of regular ECM target jammers, making them stronger and giving them greater reach. Works only with regular ECMs, not ECM Bursts.

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.

25579.name: Freebooter's Key Gamma
25579.description: This key allows you entrance into the Krur Tajar Operation Command Center.

25595.name: Alloyed Tritanium Bar
25595.description: Tritanium based alloy for use in applications requiring extremely high strength and temperature resistance. Some examples are thruster mounts or afterburner nozzles.

25611.name: Current Pump
25611.description: Used to transfer energy from a ships capacitor to a laser gain medium.

25707.name: Prototype 'Arbalest' Heavy Assault Missile Launcher I
25707.description: A launcher intended for use on cruiser-class spacecraft. While assault launchers do not possess the sheer damage-dealing capability of regular heavy missile launchers, their blend of speed and attack power lends them application across a good range of tactical situations.

25851.name: Occult Ship Data Interface
25851.description: Designed for use with Amarr technology, this portable interface permits its user to course through the electronic stream of item schematics, hunting down the stray bits of data necessary for his grand creation. Only one data interface is required for invention, and it can be re-used as often as needed.

25867.name: Pashan's Turret Handling Mindlink
25867.description:
A gunnery hardwiring implant designed to enhance skill with large energy turrets.

7% bonus to large energy turret damage.

25915.name: Large Drone Speed Augmentor I Blueprint

25931.name: Large Emission Scope Sharpener I Blueprint

25979.name: Large Energy Burst Aerator I Blueprint

26027.name: Large Bay Loading Accelerator I Blueprint

26043.name: Large Projectile Metastasis Adjuster I Blueprint

26059.name: Large Low Friction Nozzle Joints I Blueprint

26091.name: Large Core Defense Charge Economizer I Blueprint

26107.name: Large Particle Dispersion Augmentor I Blueprint

26123.name: The Little Pirate That Could
26123.description: An inspirational story if there ever was one. Fills every pirate wannabe with pride.

26283.name: Master Key
26283.description: This key unlocks all acceleration gates in the complex, most notably the R&D Circle.

26299.name: Large Remote Repair Augmentor II Blueprint

26331.name: Large Drone Repair Augmentor II Blueprint

26347.name: Large Memetic Algorithm Bank II Blueprint

26363.name: Large Signal Focusing Kit II Blueprint

26379.name: Large Energy Discharge Elutriation II Blueprint

26395.name: Large Hybrid Burst Aerator II Blueprint

26443.name: Large Thermal Shield Reinforcer II Blueprint

26459.name: Navigation for Dummies
26459.description: Gives you the answers to all the important questions, such as whether starboard is left or right.

26603.name: Occult Tuner Data Interface
26603.description: Designed for use with Amarr technology, this portable interface permits its user to course through the electronic stream of item schematics, hunting down the stray bits of data necessary for his grand creation. Only one data interface is required for invention, and it can be re-used as often as needed. The tuner interface is used in rig invention.

26779.name: Crates of Electronic Parts
26779.description: These basic elements of all electronic hardware are sought out by those who require spare parts in their hardware. Factories and manufacturers take these parts and assemble them into finished products, which are then sold on the market.

26891.name: Mobile Medium Warp Disruptor II Blueprint

26907.name: Starkmanir Slave
26907.description: The Starkmanir Tribe was virtually wiped after a failed rebellion, only a handful remain in the Empire and have now turned into collector's items for Amarrian Holder's. These slave's are rarely ever put to hard labour and generally live out their lives as exhibits for their Amarrian masters to show off. A pure blooded Starkmanir slave has made many a Holder a rich man

27083.name: Zainou 'Deadeye' Small Hybrid Turret SH-601
27083.description:
A Zainou gunnery hardwiring designed to enhance skill with small hybrid turrets.

1% bonus to small hybrid turret damage.

27099.name: Eifyr and Co. 'Rogue' Evasive Maneuvering EM-701
27099.description:
A neural interface upgrade designed to enhance pilot Maneuvering skill.

1% bonus to ship agility.

27115.name: Eifyr and Co. 'Rogue' Warp Drive Speed WS-605
27115.description:
A neural interface upgrade that boosts the pilot's skill at warp navigation.

5% bonus to ships warp speed.

27131.name: Zainou 'Gypsy' Signature Analysis SA-701
27131.description:
A neural interface upgrade that boosts the pilot's skill at operating targeting systems.

1% bonus to ships scan resolution.

27147.name: Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Biology BY-805
27147.description:
A neural Interface upgrade that boost the pilot's skill at handling boosters. 

5% bonus to attribute booster duration.

27179.name: Zainou 'Beancounter' Research RR-605
27179.description:
A neural Interface upgrade that boosts the pilot's research skills.

5% bonus to blueprint manufacturing time research.

27195.name: Poteque 'Prospector' Astrometric Rangefinding AR-802
27195.description:
A neural Interface upgrade that boosts the pilots scanning skills.

2% stronger scanning strength with scan probes.

27227.name: Zainou 'Gypsy' Long Range Targeting LT-805
27227.description:
A neural interface upgrade that boosts the pilot's skill at long range targeting.

5% bonus to max targeting range.

27243.name: Zainou 'Snapshot' Defender Missiles DM-805
27243.description:
A neural interface upgrade that boosts the pilot's skill with defender missiles.

5% bonus to the velocity of defender missiles.

27259.name: Zainou 'Snapshot' Cruise Missiles CM-601
27259.description:
A neural interface upgrade that boosts the pilot's skill with cruise missiles.

1% bonus to the damage of cruise missiles.

27323.name: Dread Guristas Mjolnir Rocket
27323.description: A small rocket with an EMP warhead.

27339.name: Caldari Navy Mjolnir Torpedo
27339.description: An ultra-heavy EMP missile. While it is a slow projectile, its sheer damage potential is simply staggering.

27355.name: Dread Guristas Inferno Torpedo
27355.description: An ultra-heavy plasma missile. While it is a slow projectile, its sheer damage potential is simply staggering.

27371.name: Caldari Navy Inferno Light Missile
27371.description: The explosion the Inferno light missile creates upon impact is stunning enough for any display of fireworks - just ten times more deadly.

27387.name: Caldari Navy Mjolnir Light Missile
27387.description: An advanced missile with a volatile payload of magnetized plasma, the Mjolnir light missile is specifically engineered to take down shield systems.

27403.name: Guristas Inferno Heavy Assault Missile
27403.description: A plasma warhead designed for use with heavy assault launchers. Heavy assault missiles can be fired at a greater rate than heavy missiles, at the expense of effective range.

27419.name: Caldari Navy Mjolnir Heavy Assault Missile
27419.description: An EMP warhead designed for use with heavy assault launchers. Heavy assault missiles can be fired at a greater rate than heavy missiles, at the expense of effective range.

27435.name: Caldari Navy Mjolnir Heavy Missile
27435.description: First introduced by the armaments lab of the Wiyrkomi Corporation, the Mjolnir heavy missile is a solid investment with a large payload and steady performance.

27451.name: Guristas Nova Heavy Missile
27451.description: The be-all and end-all of medium-sized missiles, the Nova heavy missile is a must for those who want a guaranteed kill no matter the cost.

27483.name: Legion Mjolnir Auto-Targeting Heavy Missile
27483.description: A Mordu heavy missile with an EMP warhead and automatic guidance system.

27547.name: Shadow Large Railgun Battery
27547.description: Fires a barrage of extra large hybrid slugs at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Provides high damage output and is effective at long ranges.

27579.name: Dread Guristas Phase Inversion Battery
27579.description: Analyzes incoming targeting signals and attempts to counter them by emitting an out-of-phase signal back. Great against Ladar targeting systems.

27595.name: Guristas Control Tower Medium
27595.description:
The Guristas Control Tower is an enhanced version of the Caldari control tower utilizing the latest frontier design techniques to increase its defenses and efficiency.

Racial Bonuses:
25% bonus to Missile Battery Rate of Fire
50% bonus to Missile Velocity
-75% bonus to Electronic Warfare Battery Target Cycling Speed

27627.name: Dark Blood Medium Beam Laser Battery
27627.description: Fires a deep modulated energy beam using large sized frequency crystals at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Effective at long ranges, but tracks relatively slowly and has a low rate of fire. Note: Placing a new type of crystal into the crystal compartment will result in the destruction of the crystal being replaced.

27643.name: Dread Guristas Torpedo Battery
27643.description: A launcher array designed to fit torpedos. Fires at those the Control Tower deems its enemies.

27675.name: System Scanning Array
27675.description:
Recent necessary changes to various capsuleer protocols have rendered these structures non-functional and obsolete.

The empire corporations who originally sold this structure have reached a deal with CONCORD to buy back all remaining examples.

CBD Corporation, Ducia Foundry, Material Acquisition, Minmatar Mining Corporation and Outer Ring Excavations are all now buying these structures at prices similar to the original retail price.

27771.name: Sansha Small Pulse Laser Battery
27771.description: Fires a pulsed energy beam using medium sized frequency crystals at those the Control Tower deems its enemies. Effective only at relatively short range, but tracks very fast and has a higher rate of fire than any other laser battery. Note: Placing a new type of crystal into the crystal compartment will result in the destruction of the crystal being replaced.

27803.name: Massive Sealed Cargo Containers
27803.description: These colossal containers are fitted with a password-protected security lock.

27819.name: Blood Large Beam Laser Battery Blueprint

27931.name: Medium Remote Hull Repairer I Blueprint

27947.name: Dread Guristas Cruise Missile Battery Blueprint

27979.name: Minmatar Outpost Plant Platform
27979.description: An intermediate upgrade to Minmatar Outpost manufacturing capabilities. Gives 1% Material Efficiency reduction to all manufacturing jobs (stacks with all other improvements of the same type).

28011.name: Minmatar Basic Outpost Laboratory Platform
28011.description: A basic upgrade to Minmatar Outpost research capabilities. Gives a 10% cost reduction to Material Efficiency, Time Efficiency, Copy jobs (stacks with all other improvements of the same type) and gives a research time reduction on all ME research of 20%.

28059.name: Minmatar Basic Outpost Office Platform
28059.description: A basic upgrade to Minmatar Outpost office facilities. Gives an additional seven office slots.

28091.name: Caldari Advanced Outpost Factory
28091.description: An advanced upgrade to Caldari Outpost manufacturing capabilities. Gives 1% Material Efficiency reduction to all manufacturing jobs (stacks with all other improvements of the same type) and increases the manufacturing time reduction on all Tech II components to 60%.

28107.name: Gallente Advanced Outpost Plant
28107.description: An advanced upgrade to Gallente Outpost manufacturing capabilities. Gives 1% Material Efficiency reduction to all manufacturing jobs (stacks with all other improvements of the same type).

28123.name: Minmatar Advanced Outpost Laboratory
28123.description: An advanced upgrade to Minmatar Outpost research capabilities. Gives an additional 10% cost reduction to Material Efficiency, Time Efficiency, Copy jobs (stacks with all other improvements of the same type) and increases the research time reduction on all ME research to 60%.

28363.name: Drone Cerebral Fragment
28363.description: A fragment of a rogue drones cerebral cortex.

28379.name: Domination Heavy Assault Missile Launcher
28379.description: A launcher intended for use on cruiser-class spacecraft. While assault launchers do not possess the sheer damage-dealing capability of regular heavy missile launchers, their blend of speed and attack power lends them application across a good range of tactical situations.

28395.name: Batch Compressed Dark Ochre III-Grade
28395.description: III-Grade or obsidian ochre, the most valuable member of the dark ochre family, was only first discovered a decade ago. The sleek black surface of this ore managed to absorb scanning waves, making obsidian ochre asteroids almost invisible. Advances in scanning technology revealed these beauties at last. This ore's 10% higher mineral yield makes it more than worth the effort required to find it. Considered a worthless ore for years, dark ochre was ignored by most miners until improved reprocessing techniques managed to extract the huge amount of Isogen and Mexallon inside it. Dark ochre also contains useful amounts of Nocxium. This material was compressed using an older process that compressed batches of raw materials into units using a set input quantity. Newer compression technology uses a more flexible one-to-one unit compression system.

28411.name: Batch Compressed Kernite II-Grade
28411.description: Prophets tell of the mystical nature endowed in luminous kernite, the II-Grade kernite variant. To the rest of us, it's an average looking ore that has 5% more yield than normal kernite and can make you rich if you mine it 24/7 and live to be very old. Kernite is a fairly common ore type that yields fair amounts of Mexallon and Isogen. This material was compressed using an older process that compressed batches of raw materials into units using a set input quantity. Newer compression technology uses a more flexible one-to-one unit compression system.

28427.name: Batch Compressed Scordite II-Grade
28427.description: Condensed scordite, the II-Grade cousin of normal scordite, has a 5% better yield. The increase may seem insignificant, but matters greatly to new miners where every ISK counts. Scordite is amongst the most common ore types in the central regions of known universe. It has a fair bit of Tritanium and Pyerite. Good choice for those starting their mining careers. This material was compressed using an older process that compressed batches of raw materials into units using a set input quantity. Newer compression technology uses a more flexible one-to-one unit compression system.

28443.name: Compressed Blue Ice IV-Grade
28443.description:
Interstellar ices are formed by accretion of gas molecules onto silicate dust particles. Due to its unique chemical composition and the circumstances under which it forms, blue ice will, under normal circumstances, contain more oxygen isotopes than any other ice asteroid. This particular formation is an old one and therefore contains even more than its less mature siblings.

This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

28523.name: Khanid Navy EM Armor Hardener Blueprint

28539.name: Khanid Navy Explosive Energized Membrane Blueprint

28619.name: Mercium
28619.description: The rare mineral Mercium is thought to be closely related to Omber, varying slightly in chemical composition; in fact, these ores were classified as separate types only recently. However, current refining technologies have been found to do irreparable damage to Mercium ore, rendering it unusable for all practical purposes.

28699.name: Malachite Mykoserocin
28699.description: Mykoserocin is a crystalline compound formed by intense pressure deep within large asteroids and moons. The crystals are commonly used in electronics and weapon manufacturing, as well as the creation of legalized Synth booster variants. Mykoserocin can only be found in abundance in a few areas, such as interstellar gas clouds.

28731.name: Legion Multispectral ECM
28731.description: An advanced multipurpose jamming system designed to offer blanket protection against all forms of targeting. Not as effective as the more specialized systems but is still effective against less advanced targeting systems.

28795.name: Mid-grade Centurion Omega
28795.description:
This implant does nothing in and of itself, but when used in conjunction with other Centurion implants it will boost their effect. 

25% bonus to the strength of all Centurion implant secondary effects.

28811.name: Mid-grade Virtue Epsilon
28811.description:
This social adaptation chip has been modified by Sisters of EVE scientists for use by their elite officers.

Primary Effect: +3 bonus to Charisma

Secondary Effect: 5% bonus to scan strength of probes

Set Effect: 10% bonus to the strength of all Virtue implant secondary effects

28827.name: Encrypted Data Crystals
28827.description: These crystals contain data of some sort, but have apparently been encrypted using advanced methods, making the information inaccessible to all but the most skilled hackers.

28843.name: Altered Datacore - Mechanical Engineering
28843.description: This datacore has been altered and thus rendered useless for manufacturing purposes. It has value only as a reference tool.

29003.name: Focused Warp Disruption Script
29003.description:
Originally used by the adolescent hacker group 'The Fendahlian Collective' to break past high tech security firmware, these script packs contain intricate code which modify the inherent behavior of certain modules by directly inserting commands into the firmware. The applications of such technology was not lost on the major players and the kids who invented it now head their own research divisions.

This script can be loaded into a warp disruption field generator to focus its effect upon a single ship much like a standard warp disruptor. This allows the module to disrupt ships of any size, including ships normally immune to all forms of electronic warfare.

29051.name: Capital Fusion Reactor Unit
29051.description: Power Core component used primarily in Gallente ships. A component in various other technology as well.

29067.name: Capital Linear Shield Emitter
29067.description: Shield Component used primarily in Amarr ships. A component in various other technology as well.

29083.name: Capital Particle Accelerator Unit
29083.description: Weapon Component used primarily in Blasters. A component in various other technology as well.

29099.name: Capital Superconductor Rails
29099.description: Weapon Component used primarily in Railguns. A component in various other technology as well.

29211.name: Faulty Suntendi Virtu-Real Implant
29211.description: This implant has proven unreliable at best. Due to an unforeseen complication, the implant can cause some hosts to emit erratic and intense bio-electric pulses capable of damaging nearby audiovisual technology.

29483.name: Zydrine Wine
29483.description:
This delicate wine is brewed from rice leaves. It often takes on a faint green hue akin to that of raw Zydrine ore, whence it derives its popular name.

While Zydrine wine is in fact quite potent, it is very light on the palate and has an aftertaste of green tea. The resultant tendency for drinkers to assume the wine is non-alcoholic has led to some very amusing situations.

29659.name: Unrefined Fluxed Condensates
29659.description: When combined with other materials and alloys, fluxed condensates help contribute to a unique quantum state highly conducive to efficient reactor operation.

29947.name: Enigmatic Reports
29947.description:
Completely unharmed from the destruction of Angel Captain Appakir Tarvia's vessel, this data storage unit appears to contain a wealth of information, although every last byte is encrypted in an unknown cipher that looks leagues above current data protection technology. Every attempt made to crack the code returns nothing more than a list of strange errors, none of which are typical for decryption fault analysis. More ominously still, each attempt at decryption seems to activate an internal uplink to a remote system in the Heaven constellation, with no apparent way to stop what must be outbound transmissions.

Despite the impenetrability of the data, one small image juts out among the garbled text, offering an explanation as menacing as the fact that it was clearly excluded from the encryption as some kind of warning.

30187.name: Intact Thruster Sections
30187.description:
Even after millennia of exposure to space, these thruster sections show barely any signs of mechanical wear and appear to be completely functional. The modular design of Sleeper propulsion systems is similar to that of the empires, but deviates in a few interesting areas. 

Pristine, working examples of Sleeper technology such as this are extremely rare and even more valuable. With the right skills and equipment, they can offer great insights into the scientific pursuits of the ancient race that designed them.

30251.name: Neurovisual Input Matrix
30251.description: Used in conjunction with other equipment inside the capsule, neurovisual input matrices serve the vital function of translating external stimuli into visual data. Ship identifier tags, hostile threat indicators and tactical overlay interfaces are all typical examples of N.I.M at work. The Sleeper variants of these matrices are not substantively different from contemporary devices, needing only a few supplemental components and some minor reprogramming before they can operate in much the same way. The only major deviation is in the energy efficiency. The Sleeper device is almost a thousand times less demanding on a ship's power core.

30747.name: Sleeper Drone AI Nexus
30747.description:
Rescued from the ruined hull of a Sleeper drone, this AI Nexus represents the digital soul of these strange creations. Although the technology behind the Sleeper AI is for the most part recognizable, this device offers some insight into the few mysterious aspects that are not.

As coveted as this component must be, only the foremost drone technicians in all of New Eden would be able to possibly find some use in it. There is little doubt however that the promise such a thing holds would ensure they paid a tidy sum.

30811.name: Drone Tracking Data
30811.description: An analysis of this data may help to uncover the mysteries of that evasive rogue drone.

30827.name: Dagan
30827.description: Dagan lies imprisoned within his pod. Distorted through the glass, you can see impressive, chiseled features contorted in impotent rage. He knows he is at your mercy, and has every reason to fear the "mercy" of a capsule pilot.

30875.name: Class 2 Wolf Rayet Effects
30875.description: Local spatial phenomena may cause strange effects on your ship systems.

30907.name: Smuggler's Warning About Sister Alitura
30907.description: Good news from Kirus. Remember that Sisters of EVE agent, Alitura, who nearly caught our trail? The boss called in some favors and got her reassigned to Arnon IX in Essence. The good Sister Alitura may be resourceful, but she'd need a capsuleer with clearance to all four empires to be any threat, and we know how much the Sisters love capsuleers.

30955.name: S.I Formula Sheet
30955.description:
Nothing in this file is decipherable, only the name. Serpentis could be using any one of a million different decryption methods. The good news is that a brute force attack could take as little as a few days, the bad news is that it could also take as long as a few decades. It all depends on how esoteric the cipher is, or if it's even a known, documented one. If it's a hybrid cipher, then it depends on how unique or distinctive both - assuming it's only two, of course - original parent ciphers were. A hybrid decryption analysis alone can take weeks, assuming that an original identifier for one single method is found.

It's probably best to just take this back to Isha.

30987.name: Small Trimark Armor Pump I
30987.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's total armor hit points at the expense of agility. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Armor Rigging skill.

31003.name: Small EM Armor Reinforcer II
31003.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's armor EM resistance at the expense of agility. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Armor Rigging skill.

31019.name: Capital Explosive Armor Reinforcer II
31019.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's armor explosive resistance at the expense of agility. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Armor Rigging skill.

31035.name: Medium Thermal Armor Reinforcer I
31035.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's armor thermal resistance at the expense of agility. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Armor Rigging skill.

31051.name: Small Auxiliary Nano Pump II
31051.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's armor repairer repair amount at the expense of increased power grid need for them. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Armor Rigging skill.

31067.name: Capital Nanobot Accelerator I
31067.description: This ship modification is designed to reduce a ship's armor repair cycle duration at the expense of increased power grid need for them. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Armor Rigging skill.

31083.name: Small Salvage Tackle I
31083.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's chance of salvage retrieval at the expense of agility. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Armor Rigging skill.

31115.name: Capital Auxiliary Thrusters II
31115.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's max velocity at the expense of armor amount. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Astronautics Rigging skill.

31131.name: Medium Dynamic Fuel Valve I
31131.description: This ship modification is designed to reduce the capacitor need of a ship's afterburner and microwarpdrive modules at the expense of armor amount. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Astronautics Rigging skill.

31147.name: Small Engine Thermal Shielding II
31147.description: This ship modification is designed to increase the duration of a ship's afterburner or microwarpdrive modules at the expense of armor amount. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Astronautics Rigging skill.

31163.name: Capital Hyperspatial Velocity Optimizer I
31163.description: This ship modification is designed to increase a ship's warp speed and acceleration at the expense of increased signature radius. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Astronautics Rigging skill.

31179.name: Medium Polycarbon Engine Housing I
31179.description: This ship modification is designed to increase ship's velocity and maneuverability at the expense of armor amount. Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Astronautics Rigging skill.

31195.name: Small Warp Core Optimizer II
31195.description: This ship modification is designed to reduce a ship's capacitor need for initiating warp at the expense of increased signature radius. The drawbacks of fitting this rig may be reduced by training the Astronautics Rigging skill.

31211.name: Capital Emission Scope Sharpener II
31211.description: This ship modification is designed to increase the efficiency of a ship's relic modules.

31227.name: Small Liquid Cooled Electronics I Blueprint

31243.name: Capital Memetic Algorithm Bank I Blueprint
